name: Arcanum
source:
An old woman curses a girl for her foul temper, banishing her and her entire city to a parallel world, but only the victim of the curse remembers who she is…

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Arcanum]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
一名女孩因脾气恶劣而遭到老妇人的诅咒，连同她所在的整座城市一起被放逐到平行世界。然而，唯有这个被诅咒的女孩还记得自己是谁……

摘自[url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Arcanum]romance-club.fandom[/url]
